text:
The builder is likely to recover **$14,000**: the $20,000 price, less the $5,000 saved by not finishing, less the $1,000 resale credit. This is expectation damages, which put the builder where full performance would have left him ($5,000 profit after $9,000 net sunk cost). The $3,000 increase in property value doesn't cap an expectation recovery.

CONFIDENCE: 68
